name: sqlfrontend-spike-main-limits
body: Program.Main reads each .sql file through SqlSourceReader and reports only plain CREATE declarations (ScriptDom models CREATE OR ALTER and ALTER as separate statement classes, which it skips), printing a file's diagnostics before its declarations rather than interleaved in batch order. Upgrade when Main is rewired onto SchemaEmitter, which declares CREATE OR ALTER and ALTER of views, procedures, functions and triggers.
